• About our brand and products:

Qivii is a global ethnic fashion brand specializing in premium Indian wear and imitation jewelry for women, men, and kids. Our collections include lehenga choli, sarees, salwar suits, gowns, sherwanis, kurta sets, jewelry, and festive wear designed for weddings, parties, festivals, and special occasions. We offer ready-to-wear styles, custom sizing, worldwide shipping, and trend-focused designs loved by customers across the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, and more.
